---
title: "PVJ"
---
```{r}

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

music <- read_csv("MUSIC.csv")


library(tidyverse)

music <- read_csv("MUSIC.csv")

music <- music %>%
  mutate(
    Month = fct_relevel(
      Month,
      "July", "August", "September", "October"
    )
  )

ggplot(
  music,
  aes(
    x = Month,
    y = Rank,
    color = `Primary Genre`
  )
) +
  geom_point(size = 5) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  labs(
    title = "How My Music Taste Changed",
    subtitle = "My Top 10 Songs from July to October",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Song Rank",
    color = "Primary Genre"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
